_comment: X-ray writer PU-DPO. Data: fora_report.cxr.pudpo_subset (24,000 rare-stratified TRAIN studies) -> fora_report.cxr.generate --no-plan_rules with the DPO step_000200.pt (greedy base reports) -> labels-stage X-ray extractor -> fora_report.cxr.pudpo_pairs requests -> fora_report.cxr.pudpo_edit (google/gemma-4-31B-it, vLLM, greedy, max_model_len 6144, 1,024 new tokens) -> extractor on the edits -> pudpo_pairs finalize (91,107 pairs, 23,972 studies, 29,648 visits with repeats). Training (fora_report.cxr.train_pudpo): start = reference = DPO step_000200.pt; world 40 (10 nodes x 4 GPUs); 600 steps; the paper model is step_000200.pt (best macro balanced accuracy on a 2,048-study validation subset among steps 200/400/600).
